# ffxf_account_budget (Resource)

Manages the account monthly spending budget. Requires the billing.write scope; deleting this resource removes the budget.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

resource "ffxf_account_budget" "monthly" {
  monthly = "150.00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `monthly` (String) Monthly spending cap in the account currency, as a decimal string. Leave null to remove the budget.

### Read-Only

- `cap_percent` (Number) Budget share at which machines are stopped.
- `id` (String) Stable account budget identifier.
- `month_to_date` (String) Amount spent this month.
- `percent` (Number) Percentage of the monthly budget consumed, when a budget is set.
